marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local_execu.name: Marlin Bay Dockworkers' Union Local Executive Board

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: The board met twice last week without issuing a statement on the port automation memorandum. They are aware of the international union's endorsement of a similar deal at another port last month. They have not yet decided whether to endorse the memorandum.

The port automation memorandum is a proposal that the union local may endorse or oppose. The local's executive board can issue a press release stating its position. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month. The hard cutoff for the resolution is 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00.
